result.title: PatchAdaNet: Unsupervised class incremental learning using local patches and global adapters
result.summary: Biological learning systems acquire knowledge incrementally through broad, reusable representations established early and kept largely stable, while integrating new experience with minimal interference with previously learned knowledge. Replay-based methods approximate this by storing samples or features from previous tasks and mixing them into the current task. However, memory buffers grow with the number of tasks and may retain task-specific noise that reduces generalization. To address these limitations, we propose PatchAdaNet (Patch Adapter Network), an unsupervised class-incremental learning method for image classification that continually updates feature representations using autoencoders. Since images share structural features such as edges, corners, and shapes, we first divide each image into patches and train independent autoencoders on external data to reconstruct each patch. The layers of all patch encoders are aggregated into global frozen layers that generalize across tasks and remain fixed throughout learning. Learnable adapters then build global image representations from these features to reconstruct the entire image. To prevent feature drift without storing data, we introduce the Global Feature Centroid (GFC), a fixed-size running average of adapter outputs updated after each task to penalizes representation drift. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is applied to the learnable layers to preserve previously learned features by constraining important weights. Finally, a linear classifier is trained on the frozen latent representation and GFC for class-incremental evaluation. We evaluate PatchAdaNet in both CNN and Vision Transformer settings on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, miniImageNet and 5-Datasets, providing a comparative study of the two architectures under identical class-incremental settings. Code is available.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 PatchAdaNet：将图像切分为 patch 并用外部数据训练独立自编码器，把各 patch 编码器层聚合为冻结的全局层，再用可学习 adapter 重建整图，并以固定大小的全局特征质心（GFC）加 EWC 抑制无监督类增量学习中的表示漂移，在 CNN 与 ViT 上做对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结聚合特征 + adapter 重建 + 固定大小质心惩罚漂移」的无数据回放机制，可能为 LVR 中如何在持续更新下稳定保留视觉细节、避免 latent 状态漂移与信息坍缩提供可核查的训练侧线索，但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成或多步推理。
